FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Complex Mode Bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a complex mode but where stockpiles wouldn't show in the UI after loading the game.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: a caching issue causes settlement stockpiles to not display in the Supply Chain settlement window tab after loading the game

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Warning Letter Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a bug where the letter that warns about settlements costing resources would be sent too early.

patchNoteLines.li: The letter that warns about new settlements costing resources will now be sent immediately after founding the last silver-only settlement.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Stat Tooltip Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue with settlement stat tooltip formatting.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: The happiness/loyalty/unrest/prosperity bonus from having a need surplus is not formatted correctly in the tooltip

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement Upgrading Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where upgradng a settlement can result in its needs being unment, even if the settlement has enough resources stockpiled.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: after any change that shifts a settlement's needs demand, its need could be marked as unmet, even if the settlement has enough resources stockpiled

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Stockpile Handling Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue with how stockpiles and surpluses were handled. Each day, production is accumulated into the stockpile, and then everything that needs the resource is drawn from said stockpile. However, the stockpile's cap was hard-applied throughout the whole process, rather than at the end; so over-production would immediately be sold off, and then needs and routes would drain from the cap instead of the full total. Now, the cap is only applied at the end.

patchNoteLines.li: Only apply stockpile caps at the end of the daily processing

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Mid-save Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a bug with adding Routes & Resources to an onging save.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: when Routes & Resources is added to a game mid-save, it doesn't respect the mode setting and defaults to simple mode

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Route Delivery Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where goods delivered through a route would be capped at the stockpile before being applied to needs.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: route deliveries were clamped to the stockpile cap as soon as they arrive, resulting in the complete loss of the excess
